title: Health risk assessment of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in indoor dust from Okerenkoko community, Warri, Nigeria
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, 5,1141-1161
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00430B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sisanmi Samuel Aghomi, Okpoebi Kenneth Berezi, Chilaka Diepreye
This study identifies mixed pyrogenic–petrogenic sources of PAHs in indoor dust from Okerenkoko, Nigeria, with children facing the highest health risks, highlighting urgent public health and environmental concerns.
